question: Is there a survey I can fill in, and when does it close?
note: The eval runner saved only the final answer, so no steps are shown. Statement kinds weren't saved and are shown as "fact"; every citation was checked again by code when this file was made. The start time is worked out from the report's end time and each case's duration.

event.text: You can fill in the 2027 budget survey online at engagewr.ca/ROW-2027-budget [1]. The online survey closes at 11:59 p.m. on Friday, February 26, 2027 [2]. Completing the survey also enters you into a draw for a gift card [3].
